summary: Frontend-only smoke + integration test of the /customizer 3D try-on. Verified wrist/ring/neck sculptures render as smooth, continuous ivory bodies (arm+hand+5 fingers; closed neck/shoulders bust) on both desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. Product try-ons (BG001+BG002 stacking, RG101/RG102/RG103 with finger picker, NK201/NK202/NK203) work; rings sit on the chosen finger with visible gemstones; bangles wrap the wrist. Anchor persistence, view switching, reset view, worn-items panel, add-to-cart (eshara-cart), View Product link and clear-all all work. Body-asset failure correctly shows body-model-error. One testid (panel-collapse) referenced in task is absent (only panel-toggle exists). Necklace side-chain arcs float disconnected above the pendant on all three necklaces (visual fit concern).

ui_bugs.issue: Task references data-testid=panel-collapse for desktop collapse, but only panel-toggle exists in DOM (both desktop and mobile). Not a blocker but breaks the documented selector contract.

issues: Two symmetrical gold arcs (necklace back-loop / chain) sit high on the neck near the ears and appear visually disconnected from the pendant/main design at the base of the neck. Identical arcs render across all three necklaces, so at a glance they look like floating hoops rather than a continuous chain. Consider translating the arcs down or connecting them to the bottom necklace curve so the piece reads as a single closed necklace.

AnnouncementBar marquee + main Header + Customize Your Look header stack three bars above the viewport (~7rem tall). No white gap so 'double-header white gap' criterion is satisfied, but the stack is heavy and eats vertical space, especially on mobile.
Hand model is horizontally offset so the wrist end is clipped off the left edge. Fingers stay fully visible so ring interactions still work, but framing feels off-center.

verified_flows: Wrist view renders continuous forearm+hand with 5 separated fingers (desktop + mobile).
Neck view renders smooth closed neck/shoulders bust with base plinth (desktop + mobile).
Ring view renders full hand with fingers; RG101 on index and RG102 on thumb display gemstones above finger surface (not buried).
BG001+BG002 stack on wrist without floating disconnected arm parts.
NK201/NK202/NK203 each render on the bust with unique pendant geometry.
Switching Wrist->Ring->Neck keeps persisted items (BG001 wristAnchor, RG101 indexFingerAnchor, NK201 neckAnchor) and shows only the active display sculpture.
Reset view button clickable and does not throw.
Add to cart writes correct product to localStorage 'eshara-cart' with matching productId, title, price (NK201 -> Pearl Cascade Necklace @ 8999).
View Product link href is /products/pearl-cascade-necklace (matches product slug).
Clear-all clears zustand items list to 0.
Blocking /models/body/atelier-mannequin-v1.glb triggers body-model-error boundary with useful message instead of stuck loader.
Category tabs (bangles/bracelets/rings/necklaces) all present with expected testids.
FingerPicker modal opens with finger-select-thumb/index/middle/ring/little buttons and correctly assigns anchor.
action_items: Add data-testid=panel-collapse to the desktop collapse control in WornItemsPanel (or update task/testid contract).

Revisit necklace geometry: the two upper side arcs float above the shoulders and read as disconnected from the pendant/base curve. Either link them into a single closed chain or lower them to the collarbone line so the necklace reads as one piece.
Consider centering the hand model or expanding the ring-view camera framing on <=390px viewports so the wrist end is not clipped.
critical_code_review_comments: Mannequin.tsx uses non-null assertions (model.getObjectByName('HandDisplay')!.visible = ...). If the GLB asset ever ships without one of those named nodes the effect will crash the render loop with a runtime TypeError; consider a defensive guard.

StorefrontLayout intentionally keeps AnnouncementBar + Header on /customizer. Combined with the customizer's own header this yields a ~7rem stacked chrome region and forces h-[calc(100dvh-7rem)] math. Fine, but any change to the site header height silently breaks vertical fit.

cameraView-based visibility toggle (HandDisplay vs NeckDisplay) is fine, but if the GLB ever adds more root display groups they will remain permanently visible; consider iterating all *Display children instead of hardcoding two.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks passed with minor visual/testid issues

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://jewelry-visualizer-2.preview.emergentagent.com/customizer. Zustand key 'shynish-3d-tryon' persists items[]; clear it via localStorage.removeItem before each fresh flow. Cart key is 'eshara-cart'. FingerPicker modal appears after wearing a ring - use [data-testid=finger-select-<id>] where id in {thumb,index,middle,ring,little}. Only panel-toggle exists (no panel-collapse). Reset view uses [data-testid=reset-model-view]. To test asset failure boundary use await page.route('**/atelier-mannequin-v1.glb', lambda r: r.abort()) BEFORE navigation.
rca of the issue: n/a - no blocking bugs. Necklace disconnected-chain look stems from the neck anchor geometry: the side arcs (chain back) and bottom pendant are separate mesh groups in the necklace model whose local Y offsets do not meet on the bust surface; because the bust silhouette differs from the mannequin the chain assumed, the top of the chain lands high on the throat while the pendant hangs near the collarbone, giving a floating impression. Mitigation: either bake the chain into a single continuous curve mesh or drive its top position from the neckAnchor + a bust-radius offset per view.
